title: The Books of Jeu and the Untitled Text in the Bruce Codex
author: Krause, Robinson and Wisse (eds)
description: The Books of Jeu and the Untitled Text in the Bruce Codex, the critical edition of the Coptic texts preserved in the Bruce Codex (Bodleian Library), edited from Carl Schmidt's text with English translation by Violet MacDermot, and published in the Nag Hammadi Studies series (E. J. Brill, 1978), the series being under the editorship of scholars including Martin Krause, James M. Robinson and Frederik Wisse. The two Books of Jeu, related to the Pistis Sophia, present Jesus revealing to his disciples the emanations of the 'true God' Jeu, the treasuries of light, and the seals, names, ciphers and diagrams that let the soul pass the archons on its ascent, together with baptismal rites. The Untitled Text is a sophisticated Sethian-Platonising cosmology describing the transcendent Father, the Monogenes and the structure of the Pleroma. With introduction, notes and indices, it is an essential scholarly source on later Coptic Gnosticism and ritual ascent.
